rows.text: At its meeting on 5 April 2004, the Monetary Council considered the latest economic and financial developments and decided to reduce the central bank base rate by 25 basis points, from 12.25% to 12.00%.

At its meeting on 5 April 2004, the Monetary Council considered the latest economic and financial developments and decided to reduce the central bank base rate by 25 basis points, from 12.25% to 12.00%.
